tagline: Empowering global investors with research-based data, analytics and indexes
hero_kpi_rationale: The Sustainability and Climate segment is MSCI's primary strategic growth driver, capturing the global ESG and regulatory wave, with strong structural demand in Europe and progressive adoption in the United States.
company_description: MSCI Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides research-based data, analytics, and indexes, supported by advanced technology worldwide. The Index segment provides indexes for use in various areas of the investment process, including indexed financial products, such as ETFs, mutual funds, annuities, futures, options, structured products, and over-the-counter derivatives; performance benchmarking; portfolio construction and rebalancing; and asset allocation, as well as licenses GICS and GICS Direct. The Analytics segment offers risk management, performance attribution and portfolio management content, application, an integrated view of risk and return service, and an analysis of market, credit, liquidity, counterparty, and climate risk across asset classes; managed services, including consolidation of client portfolio data, review and reconciliation of input data and results, and customized reporting; and HedgePlatform to measure, evaluate, and monitor the risk of hedge fund investments. risks.title: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
risks.summary: MSCI holds $691 million in goodwill for Real Assets and $618 million for Private Capital Solutions. A prolonged weakness in financial markets or a decline in the stock price could reduce the value of these assets and generate significant accounting losses.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the core of the report (Critical Accounting Estimates section), strong language ('materially impact', 'could be impaired in the future, which may be material'), stable trend but with heightened vigilance (Real Assets and PCS quantitatively tested in 2025 vs. qualitatively before), Capital category heavily weighted for a data company.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.summary: Three-fifths of assets managed by MSCI are invested in currencies other than the US dollar. Exchange rate fluctuations can reduce fee-based revenues from these assets without the company being able to control them.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified from the introduction (high position in the report), moderate language ('fluctuations reflect'), stable but structural trend (approximately 60% of AUM in non-USD currencies), Macro category relevant for an international group.

risks.title: Dependence on Critical Accounting Estimates
risks.summary: MSCI's financial statements rely on complex management estimates (growth rates, EBITDA margins, discount rates). Discrepancies between forecasts and reality could materially affect asset valuations.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named (Critical Accounting Estimates section), cautious language ('could materially affect the valuations'), stable trend but inherent to GAAP standards, Regulation category due to impact on accounting compliance.

risks.title: Definite-Lived Intangible Asset Impairment Risk
risks.summary: Definite-lived intangible assets (customer relationships, proprietary data, brands) acquired through mergers are tested when circumstances change. Operational or legal degradation could require impairment.
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in accounting section (mid-to-end position), moderate language ('whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate'), stable trend (no impairment in 2025), Capital category for intangible assets from acquisitions.

risks.title: Sensitivity to Revenue Growth Assumptions
risks.summary: A 100 basis point decrease in revenue growth rates or an increase in the cost of capital may not currently trigger impairment, but the margin of safety is limited for certain divisions.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in sensitivity analysis (end of goodwill section), technical language ('hypothetical decrease in revenue growth rates by 100 basis points'), stable trend but Real Assets and PCS have low margin of safety (15-39% excess), Industrial category for operational performance.
